title: Summarize known supplier aging amounts by supplier and currency
description: A purchasing user views cautious current-page monetary evidence grouped by supplier and original currency, with an optional aging-bucket split. Only active recorded invoice evidence contributes; unknown or invalid allocation amounts remain unknown. Development only; reuse ERP-140 authorized, bounded read-only supplier-aging preview and existing HTTP audit. Work solely on the current page. Preserve explicit unknown due dates, invalid/unknown allocation evidence, draft/void separation and currency isolation. Missing permission or invalid grouping fails closed. No new schema, migration, production SQL, real database execution, payment action, ledger inference, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets/.env or deployment. Verify focused tests and safe Release build/test; no real-browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Preview accepts only none/supplierCurrency/supplierCurrencyAging monetary summary modes; rejects unknown modes before source reads and reuses ERP-140 authorization and paging.

Each current-page summary retains supplier and original currency, separates unknown due date, excludes draft/void invoice amounts, sums known active gross evidence and marks allocated/remaining totals unknown if any contributing row is unknown or invalid.
Unit tests cover multi-currency suppliers, draft/void rows, unknown and overallocated evidence, empty page, page boundary, permission and no writes; document arithmetic evidence limits.
